regulation_clause.text: Closure requests must be honoured within 7 working days (subject to dues); failure incurs a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay until closure, provided no outstanding.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 19 requires calendar_day accrual. CLOSPEN2's WSDAYBAS.cpy default WS-DAY-BASIS='W' (BASIS-WORKING) causes 2000-CALC to subtract weekend days from the elapsed count before subtracting the 7-day SLA window (lines 25-27), producing a working-day-based charge count rather than calendar-day accrual under the site's own standard default.

provenance.annotator_notes: Human primary annotation and Claude verification agreed on this classification without final review.
